body:
A new Tech Debt task is titled `<feature or task title>: Tech Debt` (`board.new_debt`). The board already shows a Tech Debt label on these tasks, so the suffix just repeats it.

**Needed**
- A new Tech Debt task is titled with just the feature's title, or the completed task's title when it has no feature, with nothing added.
- Update the tests that expect the suffix (`board::tests.completing_a_task_files_its_reviews_tech_debt`, `board::tests.a_task_with_no_feature_files_its_own_tech_debt`).
- Record the change as a decision amending D-112 point 3 and D-199 point 2, which set the `: Tech Debt` title.

**Not included:** renaming Tech Debt tasks that already exist.
title: tech debt: drop ": Tech Debt" title suffix
